svg.title: Invoice retrieval — detailed process
svg.desc: Five actions: receive invoice, view invoice list, select and open invoice, download file, and review and take action. Invoices are received automatically. Users can view saved invoices after access and safety checks, even if ERP delivery is not complete. If the original is not saved, choose a permitted public source or recipient-side private connection and obtain the original. No source, denied access and failed retrieval keep original recovery open with a reason, next action and owner. R returns a retrieved file to source and role checks before delivery; its relationship to any saved copy must be proved. From the opened invoice, users can download a file or review and take action. Download is optional. Buyer actions when only a copy is available remain an open decision in SPEC026. The ERP uses Query e-invoices and Retrieve e-invoice for lists, details and file links. The file source sends the selected file through its downloadUrl. Pale green shows customer actions and ERP steps. Pale purple shows getting, checking and processing invoice files. White or light grey shows notes and what is needed before starting. Colours do not show whether a function is ready or built. E marks a problem or pending result. Matching S markers link checked saved files to the invoice list.

g.text: Invoices are received automatically. Users can view saved invoices after access and safety checks, even if ERP delivery is not complete.
Invoices are collected even when the customer is not signed in.
BEFORE YOU START · Use the business’s existing platform connections.
Check current permission for receiving, viewing and downloading invoices.
Get and save the invoice file.
Convert the file only if needed.
Send the invoice to the ERP.
Use DTS to convert a file to UBL 2.5 only in Phase 3.
Convert only if the file is not UBL 2.5.
S continues at the list request
Choose one invoice from the list.
Or review the invoice. No download needed.
Get file choices and links if needed.
Show the result and any unfinished work.
Check permission. Check that the action is available.
SPEC029 covers decisions, reports and recovery.
Show whether the list is empty,
Opening does not download or accept the
A derived file is made from the invoice.
Faithful copy: a labelled UBL copy
even while ERP delivery is pending.
ERP receipt does not mean buyer acceptance.
Buyer actions with only a copy available:
Retrieve e-invoice returns file details and links. The file source sends the file when the ERP uses the selected downloadUrl.

Solid: usual flow. Dashed: conditional work or exceptions. E: shared problem result. S: checked saved files for viewing. R: returned file for intake checks. Prove its relationship to any saved copy before ERP delivery.

E · Show the problem or pending result, the reason, the next action and who must act. Keep successful results. Retry only the failed or pending step. If the result is unknown, check what happened before trying again.
The lanes show proposed responsibilities. Implementation support still needs to be confirmed. Shared checks use each country’s rules. The ERP shows file labels and controls its own workflow.
